title: Data principal raises an access request from My requests and sends a document with it

test_data: What are you asking for: Access (s.11)
Your request: Please give me a summary of all the personal data you hold about me and who it was shared with.
Document: id-proof.pdf (any small PDF)
Note the reference shown (called RR-A in later cases).

steps.action: In Browser A open http://localhost:3001/sign-in. Under 'Sign in with' choose 'Email', type subject@cmp.local in 'Email address' and click 'Send me a code'. Ask the coordinator for the code, type it in 'Six-digit code' and click 'Verify'.
steps.expected: A 'Check your messages' box appears after the first click. After 'Verify' you are signed in and the 'My consents' page opens; the sidebar shows 'My consents' and 'My requests'.

steps.action: In the sidebar click 'My requests'.
steps.expected: The page 'My requests' opens with the text 'Ask for access to everything we hold about you, ask for it to be erased, or raise a complaint...' and a 'Make a request' button at the top right. At the foot of the page a line says naming someone to act for you is under 'My nominations'.

steps.action: Click 'Make a request'.
steps.expected: A dialog titled 'Make a request' opens with the line 'You are signed in, so this counts as verified and the clock starts now.' It has 'What are you asking for', the line 'A request is about everything we hold about you - every project and every consent.', 'Your request', a 'Documents' section marked '(optional)' with an 'Add documents' button, and a 'Send the request' button. There is no 'About' field and no list of consents to choose from.

steps.action: Open 'What are you asking for' and choose 'Access (s.11)'.

steps.action: Type the test text in 'Your request'. Click 'Add documents' and choose id-proof.pdf.
steps.expected: id-proof.pdf is listed with its size and a small X to take it off the list. The button now reads 'Add more documents'. The hint says 'PDF, image, text or Word; up to 10 files, 25 MB each.'

steps.action: Click 'Send the request'.
steps.expected: The dialog closes. A message 'Recorded as RR-YYYY-NNNNNN' appears with 'You will hear from us by <date>. 1 document sent with it.' Write down the reference (RR-A).

steps.action: Look at the new card for RR-A at the top of the list.
steps.expected: The card shows the reference, the badges 'Access · s.11' and 'Received', and the line 'Received <date and time> · you will hear by <date>'. Your request text is shown, and under it 'Documents you sent' lists id-proof.pdf with its size. There is NO yellow box saying 'We have not yet confirmed this came from you'.

steps.action: Look at the lower half of the card (it opens already expanded after sending).
steps.expected: Two columns are shown: 'Clock' with the checkpoints, and 'The path' with steps including 'Request received', 'Acknowledge', 'Identity verified?', 'A valid access request?', 'The CMP answers its own records', 'Holders found, DPO confirms', 'Tickets sent to each holder' and 'Every answer accepted?'. steps.action: Click 'Hide details', then 'Show details'.
steps.expected: The card folds to a summary - reference, badges, dates and the first lines of your request - and opens again.

steps.action: Click 'Show what was recorded' on the card.
steps.expected: A list of recorded events opens, oldest first, starting with the request being received. The button now reads 'Hide what was recorded'.

steps.action: Ask the coordinator to check the outbox for an acknowledgement sent to subject@cmp.local.
steps.expected: An acknowledgement for RR-A is in the outbox, quoting the reference and the date by which she will hear.

pass_criteria: The access request is about everything held (no consent picker), is recorded with an RR- reference, is verified by the session, carries the document she attached, and shows 'Received' with its clock and path; an acknowledgement is sent.

title: Ticket moves: a final reminder only once overdue, sent to someone else (the old link stops working), withdrawn and reopened

role: DPO on console; outside holder on the portal
preconditions: The console is running at http://localhost:3000.

steps.action: Click 'Send tickets'. Set 'Answer by' to yesterday's date and click 'Send the ticket'.

steps.action: Ask the coordinator for the link email sent to uat.desk01@example.org and keep the link (called L1).

steps.action: Click 'Send final reminder' on the row.

steps.action: Click 'Send final reminder' in the box.

steps.action: Ask the coordinator for the newest emails to uat.desk01@example.org and uat.desk02@example.org.
steps.expected: uat.desk01@example.org was told the ticket has moved; uat.desk02@example.org received a new link (L2), different from L1.

steps.action: In Browser B open the ticket, click 'More', choose 'Withdraw', type the reason in 'Why' and click 'Withdraw the ticket'.
